newsitem.title: USA: Argentina wins $100 mln loan for businesses.
newsitem.headline: Argentina wins $100 mln loan for businesses.

text.p: The Inter-American Development Bank on Sunday said it was giving Argentina a $100 million loan to help small- and medium-sized businesses become more competitive.
The funds were expected to benefit an estimated 2,500 businesses by financing technical assistance and training services to be identified in business development plans.
The total cost of the programme was $200 million, the IADB said. The IADB loan is for 20 years, with a 3.5-year grace period at the variable interest rate, now 6.76 percent.
